"""Compara cada reporte.html regenerado con HEAD y muestra los fragmentos que difieren."""
import difflib, re, subprocess, sys

for exp in ["control", "h1", "h2", "h3", "sampling_1"]:
    ruta = f"experimentos/{exp}/informe/reporte.html"
    viejo = subprocess.run(["git", "show", f"HEAD:{ruta}"], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout
    nuevo = open(ruta).read()
    tok = lambda s: re.split(r"(<[^>]+>)", s)
    sm = difflib.SequenceMatcher(None, tok(viejo), tok(nuevo), autojunk=False)
    a, b = tok(viejo), tok(nuevo)
    difs = [(("".join(a[i1:i2]))[:200], ("".join(b[j1:j2]))[:200]) for op, i1, i2, j1, j2 in sm.get_opcodes() if op != "equal"]
    print(exp, len(difs))
    for d in difs[:5]:
        print("  -", d[0]); print("  +", d[1])
